lede: The web ran quiet this Friday, October 9: just one story surfaced on more than one feed at once, Grand Theft Auto V Legacy landing on both Steam's charts and YouTube's trending videos the same day. Otherwise the day's attention scattered across unrelated corners. The most-read article on Wikipedia was Nana Patekar, close to 1.67 million views, and on GitHub the fastest-rising project was AnyPS5, a tool for porting PS5 executables to Linux and Windows, up 4,669 stars in a single day.
